changes.original_question: When did the hula hoop make its debut?
changes.new_question: In what year did Wham-O's modern Hula Hoop make its market debut?
changes.reason: Explicitly restrict debut to the commercial Wham-O product, not ancient hoop play or a later patent. Supplement the missing market-event premise with the original trademark record; this is a disclosed scope clarification.

changes.original_question: In the nursery rhyme, which was the last creature eaten by the woman who swallowed a fly?
changes.new_question: In the supplied version of the nursery rhyme about the woman who swallowed a fly, which was the last creature she ate?
changes.reason: Specify the supplied version, drawn from CLAS printed pages198–199. That version ends with a horse and pie, not a death line; the requested property remains the last creature, not last food.

changes.original_question: Washington University in St. Louis and University of Colorado, are located in which country?
changes.new_question: Washington University in St. Louis and University of Colorado, are located in which country?
changes.reason: Original question unchanged. Add an explicit Colorado-to-USA bridge supported by university contact/location material and the Library of Congress state guide.

changes.original_question: What is the state capital of Ohio?
changes.new_question: What is the state capital of Ohio?
changes.reason: Original question unchanged. Supply the capital relation explicitly from Ohio government material; retain the original largest-city background without treating it as proof of capital status.

changes.original_question: Who sang the original oh where oh where can my baby be?
changes.new_question: Who sang the original oh where oh where can my baby be?
changes.reason: Original lyric question unchanged. Add its Last Kiss title bridge from the official artist audio description; retain the released1961 original-version metadata and distinguish later covers.

changes.original_question: When was the us involved in the korean war?
changes.new_question: During which years did U.S. forces conduct Korean War combat campaigns, up to the armistice?
changes.reason: Clarify involvement as wartime combat campaigns up to the armistice, not all subsequent US military presence. Supplement the original outbreak-only passage with the official US campaign interval; no date appears in the clarified question.

changes.original_question: What is the surname of the family in the book Little Women by Louisa May Alcott?
changes.new_question: What is the surname of the family in the book Little Women by Louisa May Alcott?
changes.reason: Original question unchanged. Add the fictional-family relation from Alcott original public-domain novel, rather than using author biography or a gold answer.

changes.original_question: What is the name of the Japanese dish of bite-sized pieces of raw fish served with dipping sauces, vegetables and wasabi?
changes.new_question: What is the name of the Japanese dish of bite-sized pieces of raw fish served with dipping sauces, vegetables and wasabi?
changes.reason: Original question unchanged. Supply the explicit dish/preparation mapping from Japanese government food material, distinguishing raw-fish sashimi from rice-based sushi.
